name: Find a way out of the town
description: Find a way beyond the quarantine perimeter. Follow Viktor Petrov and Irina Kovalenko's accounts of a missing guard and the old service-gate key, or seek official help from Pavel Sokolov.

stages.description: Run east to Center. Avoid patrols and whatever else lurks in the night.
Ask Viktor Petrov about the guard who carried a key to the old service gate.
Ask Irina Kovalenko about the shadow and scream when the guard disappeared.
Defeat the huge creature at the factory at night and search its remains for the missing guard's service-gate key. Pavel Sokolov may instead help arrange an authorized departure.
You recovered a strange key. Try the old service gate at the factory perimeter, or pursue Pavel Sokolov's authorized checkpoint route.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Long-term escape objective: discover a service-gate key from the Titan OR earn a government exit permit.
implementationNotes: Retain existing run-east and Titan-key progression for old saves.
Existing strange-key stage uses pending: implement gate interaction and a parallel official-permit completion route via runtime extension.
Never require the Titan kill for the official route.
_codex.compatibility: _codex is design metadata, not an executable trigger. Keep all original IDs, trigger shapes, rewards, and existing save compatibility. Add runtime support only after implementing the documented systems.

escapeCompletion.implementation: Replace pending with a runtime completion handler that checks either route; do not add both as sequential stages. On exit set prologue_complete, ending_route and transition to next district. Preserve original strange-key pickup for older saves.
